notes: Hotmail/Outlook accounts now feed Facebook email codes automatically everywhere the tool reads a mail code (Check Login, auto-relogin, 24/7 warmup, browser and page flows): when an email code is needed and the account has no saved token - or the token is dead - the tool silently runs that account's Just Login on its own proxy + Android user-agent, gets a fresh token, then reads the Facebook code straight from the mailbox, exactly like the other mail providers. The right-click Hotmail menu (Just Login / Check Token / Change Password / Add Recovery / ...) now runs the selected accounts in parallel - a rolling pool of 25 (one finishes, the next starts) instead of one-by-one - with the account store made concurrency-safe so parallel logins never overwrite each other's tokens. And when an account's email is a real webmail the tool has no reader for (not Hotmail / mail.td / 5smail / tempmail.plus / smvmail / fviainboxes), it now says 'Mail not supported' at once instead of waiting out the whole timeout.
